fails_if: `compile_enrichment` collects an alias's variant keys from only one chosen record instead of every record of the variable, so FormerA attaches to only one of the `people` and `others` variants; or `apply_alias_cases` adds availability for a search alias, so FormerA gains a state; or the writer gives a search alias a window; or `variable_search_text` (derive/search_index.py) stops indexing the variable's own description or any published spelling, the search alias included
note: From the resolved-writer tests: the old FTS test found the variable by its description and by a delivery column name, and the old alias test wrote a search-only alias ('HistoricalSearchOnly') to variable_alias with no window. Here FormerA is that search-only alias and A the delivered column.
